import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
iris = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a pairplot with hue based on the species
pairplot = sns.pairplot(iris, hue="species", markers=["o", "s", "D"],
                        plot_kws={'alpha':0.7, 's':60, 'edgecolor':'w'}, 
                        diag_kind='hist', diag_kws={'alpha':0.5})

# Add a title and adjust layout
pairplot.fig.suptitle("Iris Dataset Pairplot by Species", y=1.02)
pairplot.fig.subplots_adjust(top=0.95)  # Adjust the top of the plots to fit the title

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
